scope: Single-series ATR and candle geometry source code; no structural pivot or trading decisions
seed: Mean of first n true ranges, excluding first input candle
candle_baseline: ATR after previous closed candle; zero is distinct from unavailable

floating_point.grid_tolerance_role: Binary representation allowance only; not a new trading price tolerance
floating_point.pine_comparison: int(math.sign(a-b)) avoids direct float comparison rounding
floating_point.unsupported_precision: Fail closed; do not weaken golden-vector tolerance

chart_adapters.anchor_match: Exact chart bar-open timestamp; never silently start at first later loaded bar
chart_adapters.pine_anchor_clock: input.time Unix milliseconds interpreted in chart context
chart_adapters.mql_anchor_clock: Broker chart datetime; not automatically UTC
chart_adapters.pine_current_bar: Process only barstate.isconfirmed; no varip, requests or lookahead
chart_adapters.mql_current_bar: Always exclude series index zero, including market-closed last bar
chart_adapters.mql_history_changes: Recompute from anchor on new bar, changed oldest bar, or prev_calculated reset to zero
chart_adapters.mql_inputs: Explicit series indexing for time and OHLC arrays
chart_adapters.pine_quantum_default: syminfo.mintick; explicit override must match the input grid
chart_adapters.mql_quantum_default: _Point (chart precision); explicit override must match the input grid
chart_adapters.historical_availability: Assume terminal-provided finalized history; receipt timestamps unavailable
chart_adapters.missing_bars: Session-gap versus feed-loss cannot be inferred by these wrappers; no complete feed-integrity claim
chart_adapters.chart_type: Standard raw OHLC only; Pine rejects nonstandard charts; MetaTrader offline/custom chart provenance remains a user check

fixture_harness.eligibility_checked_by: Existing strict Python fixture parser, including as_of and contiguous available prefix
fixture_harness.identity_clock_fields: Prevalidated and bound by fixture hash, not measured by the arithmetic harness
fixture_harness.pine_execution: One embedded fixture row per confirmed chart bar starting at bar_index zero; require enough bars and verify Processed rows
fixture_harness.mql_execution: Self-contained script over embedded arrays; logs row count and mismatch count

explicit_user_scope: MetaTrader not installed; prepare code and local tests only
